abstract: As a method to elucidate the histogenesis of this tumor, it is necessary to make a comparative study of the morphological relation between the histopathology of the tumor and the mother tissue which is considered to be the origin of the tumor. Therefore, as already reported, since we induced the yolk sac tumor by treating the fetal membrane of pregnant rats with carcinogenic agents, we have comparatively studied the tumor tissue and the fetal membrane, which is considered the mother tissue, to elucidate the histogenesis by seeking the similarity between them and the common features and obtained the following conclusions. First, the presence of PAS positive non-glycogenic granules was noted in both cytoplasms, and then the localization of AFP was confirmed in both cytoplasms also in the study with a fluorescence antibody method using anti-rat AFP antibody. Further, in the observation at the level of electron microscopy, as findings common to both, we noted the presence of round homogeneous non-structural substance and characteristically developed r-ER, and, on the other hand, immature nuclei containing thread-like nucleolonema, considered characteristic to germ cell tumor. From the above results, this induced tumor was considered to have developed from the rat fetal membrane as mother tissue.
abstract_ja: この腫瘍の組織発生を解明するためには、腫瘍組織の病理組織学と、腫瘍の起源と考えられる母体組織との形態学的関係を比較検討することが必要である。そこで、既報のとおり、妊娠ラットの胎児膜に発癌物質を作用させて卵黄嚢腫瘍を誘発し、腫瘍組織と母体組織と考えられる胎児膜を比較検討し、両者の類似性と共通の特徴を求めることにより組織発生を検討して、以下の結論を得た。第一に、両細胞質にPAS陽性の非グリコーゲン性顆粒が認められ、抗ラットAFP抗体を用いた蛍光抗体法でも両細胞質にAFPの局在が確認された。さらに電子顕微鏡レベルの観察では、両者に共通する所見として、円形で均質な非構造物質と特徴的に発達した粗面小胞体(r-ER)を認めた。一方、糸状の核小体を含む未熟な核は胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的と考えられた。以上の結果より、この誘発腫瘍は母体組織である胎児膜から発生したものと考えられた。
